The type is set at the connector level not at the widget level. Currently this type is incorrect.

I wonder if the current shape of the object is appropriate. We can only have an object with one key which is non defined in advance. It makes it a bit complicated to manipulate it below ([L402](https://github.com/algolia/instantsearch.js/pull/4140/files#diff-a07b6c7d4c8f3ebd0777d2622f2dc912R402)). Why not an object with a pre-defined structure where we can easily access the values? Or even a tuple? 

It would be simpler to traverse at the next step.
We already have access to the needed widgets inside `widget` if I'm not mistaken.

There is some cases where we don't have a 1:1 mapping for connector/widget e.g. `range`, we don't have a `range` widget. We already have a hard-coded list we could create a real mapping of widgets that maps to the `uiState`.
